stats.notes: CDS C1 for fall 2025 (the TSU 2025-26 CDS files are headed 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' but ask for Fall 2025 data): 8,804 applied, 7,451 admitted (85%), 457 enrolled. International: 84 applied, 81 admitted (96%), 4 enrolled. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11. pct_submit_sat/act are the C9 percentages (138 SAT, 307 ACT of the 457 enrolled). C7 factors: academic GPA and test scores very important, rigor and class rank considered, everything else not considered (the x marks were readable). Undergraduate enrollment 4,221 and 74 nonresident undergraduates are from B1/B2 (fall 2025); student-to-faculty ratio 11 to 1 is CDS I-2 (College Navigator shows 13 to 1).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'required to be considered for admission'.

cost.notes: College Navigator estimates for full-time beginning undergraduates, 2024-25 (the latest published there): tuition AND fees in-state $8,616, out-of-state $22,416; on-campus food and housing $11,150; books $1,600; other expenses $5,811. The TSU 2025-26 CDS left section G blank (final costs due 7/1/2026) and its 2026-27 tuition schedule is a scanned image, so newer figures could not be read; TSU says to expect 2-5% increases. No separate international tuition rate is stated on the pages reviewed, so out-of-state is the likely rate. CDS H6 (nonresident undergraduates): institutional need-based aid is available; 84 received it, average $19,162, total $1,609,573.
